d: The gardens of the palace of the Duke of Arcos. – At the bottom, a colonnade; on the left, the entrance of a chapel; on the right, a throne prepared for the feast. At the rise of the curtain, Spanish soldiers, led by Selva, cross the colonnade. Alphonse, People's Choir, outside.
Alphonse, Lorenzo

Elvire, the Choir, a Lady of Honour. Walk and procession; Elvire appears surrounded by the young Spanish girls his companions and Neapolitan lords. Dances precede his arrival: young Neapolitans present him with flowers.
The Same; Fenella, pursued by Selva and by Guards.
The same; Alphonse, giving his hand to Elvire, and surrounded by all the Lords of the Court. (Final)
A picturesque site in the vicinity of Naples. In the bottom the sea. Fishermen are busy preparing their nets and nacelles; others are engaged in various games. Masaniello, Borella, Fishermen.
The Same; Pietro
The same; Fenella.
Masaniello, Fenella.
Masaniello, Borella, Fenella, Fishermen. (Final)
The same; Pietro.
A palace apartment. Alphonse, Elvire.

The great square of the market of Naples. One sees the arrival, dancing, of young girls carrying baskets of flowers or fruit on their heads; fishermen and peasants arrive bringing their food. The market opens: the flowers and fruits rise on each side. Fenella, Young Girls, Fishermen, Villagers, Inhabitants of Naples. While young girls and boys are dancing, people of Naples, followed by their stewards or porters (facchini) pass through the market alleys, market, buy, and several lazzaroni, to whom they give coins or baskets of fruit, testify their joy and join the dancers. During this time, Fenella entered with those of his companions who were seen in the second act; they place themselves on the front of the theatre, and have in front of them baskets of fruit.
The Same; Selva, Several Soldiers who spread in the market. (Final)
The same; Masaniello, Pietro, Fishermen.

The interior of Masaniello's cabin The bottom of it is closed by a ship's veil. On the right, a chair and a table; on the left, a mat that serves as a bed in Masaniello. Masaniello, seated, The Marquis Of Column, A Magistrate, The Chief of Justice, and The Main Inhabitants of Naples, standing and grouped around Masaniello.
Masaniello, Fenella, shot down and staggering.
The same; Pietro, Fishermen.
Fenella, Alphonse, Elvire, wrapped in a coat, head covered with a black veil.
The same; Masaniello
The same; Pietro, Borella, Some Conjures.

The bottom of the cabin, which was closed by a sail of the ship, is now opening. We see the main inhabitants of Naples bringing to Masaniello the keys of the city. The procession carries palms and crowns. Fenella, Masaniello, Pietro. (Marche and Choir)

The vestibule of the palace of the viceroy. On the left, a large stone staircase leading to a terrace. At the bottom, in the distance, the summit of Vesuvius. Pietro, Fishermen, Young Daughters of the People. They come out of the apartment to the left, which is that of the feast. It is the end of an orgy: they hold cups, vases filled with wine; others hold guitars. (Bacarolle)
The same; Borella, leaving the apartment on the left. (Final)
The same; Masaniello. The disorder of his clothes heralds the trouble of his spirits.
The same; Fenella.
Fenella, Elvire, Borella.
